snippet.title: X-Men 2: Battle JAVA GAME (Marvel 2003 year) All Characters
snippet.description:
X-Men2 : Battle - A mutant nicknamed the Nightcrawler plans to destroy the president, by the time William Stryker captures Dr. Xavier and tries to pit the mutants with each other using a cerebral hemisphere.
Of course, the brotherhood of Magneto's mutants will not stand aside and will try to extract the greatest benefit from this conflict. And again, X-Men must restore the balance of this world!
Save the world from evil by playing Storm. Try to find out about your past playing as Wolverine. Find the right path through the game as the Nightcrawler.
